Package game.items.food

Class DriedProduct

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.items.food.ConsumableItem
game.items.food.ProcessedProduct
game.items.food.DriedProduct
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Consumable, Processable
public class DriedProduct extends ProcessedProduct
A single "Dried" processing layer, produced by a DryingRack. Each Dried layer restores 2 stamina to the Actor when consumed, on top of the preceding product's own effect.
